Hex String Converter

Encode text to hex (UTF-8) and decode hex back to text, with optional 0x prefixes, separators and uppercase output.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the direction: text → hex or hex → text.
  2. Type or paste your input.
  3. Adjust options (0x prefix, separators, case) and copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it handle emoji and non-English text?

Characters are encoded as UTF-8 bytes, so emoji and non-Latin scripts work: 'é' becomes c3a9 (2 bytes), '😀' becomes f09f9880 (4 bytes).

Can I paste hex with spaces or 0x prefixes?

The decoder strips 0x prefixes, spaces, dashes, colons and newlines automatically, so you can paste hex copied from logs, editors or debuggers.

What input is rejected?

Odd-length hex, characters outside 0-9/a-f, and invalid UTF-8 byte sequences are rejected with a clear error message.
